decisions.reason: Its quantified customer savings signal performance above aspiration, and in a growing firm with slack and strong fit to the core offer there is little reason to reallocate these resources.

As a close-to-core machine that remained on offer without any visible failure signal, it is likely to stay while management continues learning from market experience under favorable growth conditions.
Because it is a flagship line tied to the firm's modular environmental-technology direction, management would protect it unless results clearly fell below aspiration, which is not indicated.
This newly launched shredder line is close to established capabilities, so with organisational slack and no evidence of underperformance the firm would likely give it more time to prove itself.

Although somewhat more exploratory than the core lines, the new screen line fits the firm's processing-systems trajectory and would usually be retained for another year unless early results trigger problemistic search.
